_comment: Activation source is NOT one column. It is derived from two:
referrals."referrer_role "  -- the employee who prompted the referral
referrer_role is only populated when an EMPLOYEE mediated the referral:
'Referral - Existing Cx via Emp' -> 85% have a role
The blanks are therefore not missing data. They mean no employee was
involved, i.e. the customer referred on their own. So role is checked
first, and source supplies the answer when there is no role.
Unmapped values land in Others AND are reported in the build log.
